--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @FromDate datetime = '2019-10-01 00:00:00:000' --Declare @ToDate datetime = '2020-04-22 00:00:00:000' --Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 2

FROM SET_DocumentType
INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1

--inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber --and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType --and GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID = AR_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND --GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND --GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
--INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND --GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND --GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID
LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
left join AP_PurchaseOrderHeader on AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AR_InvoiceDetail.PurchaseOrderHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.Status = 1
--LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID -- and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID
--LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID -- AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1
--left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid -- AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID -- --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode in (1) -- LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode

where AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID ),0) as CPRNO

inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorID

inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID inner join AR_SET_BusinessPartner on AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode and (AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName LIKE 'Brokerage' OR AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName LIKE 'Commission')

where AR_SET_Customer.TaxationStatusID <> -1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID IN @CompanyID and AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = 1 and AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
